description.value: As an immediate action, a thief with this talent can attempt an Escape Artist check in place of a Reflex saving throw against any effect that would immobilize her or impose the entangled condition on her. Additionally, when she is the target of a grapple combat maneuver, as an immediate action the thief can attempt an Escape Artist check using the result of the skill check in place of her CMD against that combat maneuver attempt. A thief of less than 10th level can only use this second ability once per opponent per day, but at 10th level this limitation no longer applies.
